newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP assigns Dai Hung stake to Petronas.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP assigns Dai Hung stake to Petronas.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said on Friday it had assigned its 43.75 percent stake in the Dai Hung oilfield off the coast of Vietnam to Malaysia's national oil firm Petronas.
BHP said the assignment of the stake and the operatorship of the field required the approval of the Vietnam government, which it expected shortly.
Petronas said earlier this year that it had acquired the 43.75 percent stake, but BHP has not previously announced that it had assigned the holding.
BHP said the assignment was effective from December 1 last year.
The company, Australia's largest listed firm, wrote down the Dai Hung stake last year due to disappointment at lower-than-expected reserves and regulatory problems with the Vietnamese government.
Dai Hung was originally thought to hold 800 million barrels but was now estimated to hold only 100 million barrels.
Petronas already has a 20 percent stake in the field.
The other shareholders are Petrovietnam with 15 percent while France's Total Sa TOTF.SA and Japan's Sumitomo Corp each have 10.625 percent.
